name: Puniemu (Yo-kai Watch Puni Puni / Wibble Wobble)
author: puniemu@example.com
description: Private server emulator for Yo-kai Watch Puni Puni (JP 4.177.0) and Wibble Wobble. The install builds the server and sets up everything by itself: game data from the official servers, real crank-a-kai odds and a full English translation.
startup: if [ -n "${HTTPS_CERT}" ]; then export ASPNETCORE_URLS="https://0.0.0.0:{{SERVER_PORT}}" ASPNETCORE_Kestrel__Certificates__Default__Path="${HTTPS_CERT}" ASPNETCORE_Kestrel__Certificates__Default__Password="${HTTPS_CERT_PASSWORD}"; else export ASPNETCORE_URLS="http://0.0.0.0:{{SERVER_PORT}}"; fi; ./app/Puniemu

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Puniemu install / update - sets everything up by itself:
#   1. builds the server from git into app/
#   2. base data (Puniemu's stage_data, gacha_pool ...) from a repository with Resources/
#   3. current master tables (+ optional assets) from the official servers
#   4. real crank-a-kai odds, English dictionary from Wibble Wobble, machine translation of the rest
# Your files (Resources/ extras, data/ saves, appsettings.json, own translations) are kept.
set -e
warn() { echo "WARNING: $*"; }
apt-get update -qq >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
apt-get install -y -qq git ca-certificates curl python3 python3-venv >/dev/null 2>&1 || warn "apt-get failed (git/python3 needed)"

REPO="${PUNIEMU_REPO:-https://github.com/Elas711/puniemu-edited.git}"
BRANCH="${PUNIEMU_BRANCH:-master}"
if [ -n "${GIT_TOKEN}" ]; then REPO="${REPO/https:\/\//https:\/\/x-access-token:${GIT_TOKEN}@}"; fi
SRV=/mnt/server
CACHE=$SRV/.cache
SRC=/tmp/puniemu-src
OUT=/tmp/puniemu-out

echo "=== 1/4 Building Puniemu (${BRANCH}) ==="
rm -rf "$SRC" "$OUT"
git clone --depth 1 --branch "${BRANCH}" "${REPO}" "$SRC"
case "$(uname -m)" in aarch64|arm64) RID=linux-arm64 ;; *) RID=linux-x64 ;; esac
cd "$SRC"
dotnet publish Puniemu.csproj -c Release -r "$RID" --self-contained true -o "$OUT" -p:DebugType=none -v q -nologo
cd "$SRV"
rm -rf app && mkdir -p app && cp -r "$OUT"/. app/
chmod +x app/Puniemu
mkdir -p Resources dataDownload data Translations/en Events AssetOverlay Tools "$CACHE"
cp -r "$SRC"/Translations/. Translations/
cp -rn "$SRC"/Events/. Events/ 2>/dev/null || true
cp -r "$SRC"/Tools/. Tools/
cp "$SRC"/appsettings.example.json appsettings.example.json
[ -f appsettings.json ] || echo '{}' > appsettings.json
rm -rf "$SRC" "$OUT"

# ---- ready-made data from your private data repository (Resources, translations, archive assets) ----
USE_DATA=""
if [ -n "${DATA_REPO}" ]; then
    echo "=== Data repository ${DATA_REPO} ==="
    DREPO="${DATA_REPO}"
    if [ -n "${GIT_TOKEN}" ]; then DREPO="${DREPO/https:\/\//https:\/\/x-access-token:${GIT_TOKEN}@}"; fi
    rm -rf "$CACHE/data"
    if git clone -q --depth 1 --branch "${DATA_BRANCH:-main}" "$DREPO" "$CACHE/data"; then
        [ -d "$CACHE/data/Resources" ] && cp -r "$CACHE/data/Resources/." Resources/
        [ -d "$CACHE/data/Translations" ] && cp -r "$CACHE/data/Translations/." Translations/
        [ -d "$CACHE/data/dataDownload" ] && cp -r "$CACHE/data/dataDownload/." dataDownload/
        echo "Resources/: $(ls Resources | wc -l) files, translations and archive assets copied"
        USE_DATA=1
        rm -rf "$CACHE/data"
    else
        warn "could not clone the data repository (private? set Git token) - falling back to the automatic set-up"
    fi
fi

echo "=== 2/4 Base data ==="
if [ -z "$USE_DATA" ] && [ -n "${BASE_DATA_REPO}" ]; then
    rm -rf "$CACHE/base"
    if git clone -q --depth 1 --filter=blob:none --sparse --branch "${BASE_DATA_BRANCH:-master}" "${BASE_DATA_REPO}" "$CACHE/base" \
        && git -C "$CACHE/base" sparse-checkout set Resources && [ -d "$CACHE/base/Resources" ]; then
        cp -rn "$CACHE/base/Resources/." Resources/
        echo "Resources/: $(ls Resources | wc -l) files"
    else
        warn "could not get the base data - upload Resources/ yourself"
    fi
fi

echo "=== 3/4 Game data from the official servers ==="
if [ -z "$USE_DATA" ] && [ "${FETCH_GAME_DATA}" = "true" ]; then
    rm -rf "$CACHE/master"
    if ./app/Puniemu --fetch-game-data --version "${GameVersion:-4.177.0}" --resources "$CACHE/master"; then
        cp -r "$CACHE/master/." Resources/
    else
        warn "the official server did not give the master tables (wrong Game version?) - the base data is used"
    fi
fi
if [ "${FETCH_ASSETS}" = "true" ]; then
    # asset list from the official server (needs the master tables; uses a copy so Resources/ stays as it is)
    ./app/Puniemu --fetch-game-data --version "${GameVersion:-4.177.0}" --resources "$CACHE/master" --assets "$SRV/dataDownload" \
        || warn "asset download incomplete - Reinstall continues where it stopped"
fi

echo "=== 4/4 Crank-a-kai odds and translations ==="
if [ -z "$USE_DATA" ] && [ "${AUTO_SETUP}" = "true" ]; then
    if python3 -m venv /tmp/venv >/dev/null 2>&1; then PY="/tmp/venv/bin/python -I"; else PY="python3 -I"; fi
    # real crank-a-kai pools from the official odds pages
    $PY Tools/fetch_gacha_rates.py --resources Resources --out Resources/gacha_pool.txt --merge | tail -2 \
        || warn "crank-a-kai odds not fetched"
    if [ "${Language}" = "en" ]; then
        # English names / texts of Wibble Wobble lined up with the Japanese tables
        if [ -d "$CACHE/master" ] && [ -d "$CACHE/base/Resources" ]; then
            $PY Tools/build_translation.py build --jp "$CACHE/master" --en "$CACHE/base/Resources" \
                --out Translations/en/strings.generated.json | tail -2 || warn "Wibble Wobble dictionary not built"
        fi
        # everything still Japanese -> offline machine translation (Sugoi v4, CPU)
        if [ "${MACHINE_TRANSLATE}" = "true" ]; then
            env PUNIEMU_RESOURCES_PATH="$SRV/Resources" TranslationsPath="$SRV/Translations" EventsPath="$SRV/Events" \
                ServerStatePath=/tmp/state.json Database=sqlite SqlitePath=/tmp/x.db Language=en IsWibWob="${IsWibWob:-false}" GameVersion="${GameVersion:-4.177.0}" \
                ./app/Puniemu --export-untranslated "$CACHE/untranslated.json" | tail -1 || warn "export failed"
            M="$CACHE/sugoi"
            B="https://huggingface.co/${MT_MODEL_REPO:-entai2965/sugoi-v4-ja-en-ctranslate2}/resolve/main"
            if [ ! -s "$M/model.bin" ]; then
                echo "Downloading the translation model (1.1 GB, once)..."
                mkdir -p "$M/spm"
                for f in config.json source_vocabulary.json target_vocabulary.json spm/spm.ja.nopretok.model spm/spm.en.nopretok.model model.bin; do
                    curl -sSfL --retry 3 -o "$M/$f" "$B/$f" || warn "model file $f missing"
                done
            fi
            if [ -s "$M/model.bin" ] && [ -s "$CACHE/untranslated.json" ]; then
                /tmp/venv/bin/pip install -q ctranslate2 sentencepiece 2>/dev/null || python3 -m pip install -q --break-system-packages ctranslate2 sentencepiece
                echo "Machine-translating (about 10-30 minutes on a normal CPU; a Reinstall continues where it stopped)..."
                $PY Tools/machine_translate.py --input "$CACHE/untranslated.json" --model "$M" \
                    --translations Translations/en --out Translations/en/machine.generated.json | tail -3 \
                    || warn "machine translation stopped - Reinstall to continue"
            fi
        fi
    fi
fi

echo ""
echo "Install complete. Start the server; the admin panel is at /admin (Admin token variable)."

variables.name: Git repository
variables.description: Repository the server is built from (Reinstall to update).

variables.name: Git branch
variables.description: Branch or tag to build. Use master once the work is merged there.

variables.name: Git token
variables.description: GitHub token with read access to private repositories (the data repository). Fine-grained token: Contents = Read-only.

variables.name: Data repository
variables.description: Private repository with ready-made Resources/, Translations/ and archive assets. Needs the Git token. When it is used, the automatic data / translation steps are skipped. Empty = set up automatically.

variables.name: Data branch
variables.description: Branch of the data repository.

variables.name: Base data repository
variables.description: A git repository with a Resources/ folder (Puniemu's stage_data, gacha_pool, mission_cfg ... + master tables). Empty = upload Resources/ yourself.

variables.name: Base data branch
variables.description: Branch of the base data repository.

variables.name: Download master tables
variables.description: true = get the current master tables from the official server at every (re)install (needs the current Game version). Overwrites ywp_mst_* files.

variables.name: Download assets
variables.description: true = also download all asset files (~75,000 files, several GB) into dataDownload/. Later reinstalls only fetch new files.

variables.name: Crank-a-kai odds + translations
variables.description: true = at every (re)install fetch the real crank-a-kai odds and (Language = en) build the English dictionary from Wibble Wobble.

variables.name: Machine translation
variables.description: true = machine-translate every text that is still Japanese (offline Sugoi v4 model, 1.1 GB download once, 10-30 min CPU; non-commercial licence).

variables.name: Translation model (Hugging Face)
variables.description: CTranslate2 Japanese -> English model in the Sugoi layout.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: Shown in the game's dialogs and the web pages.

variables.name: Admin token
variables.description: Password for the admin panel at /admin. Use a long random string; empty = admin panel off.

variables.name: Game
variables.description: false = Puni Puni (JP), true = Wibble Wobble.

variables.name: Game version
variables.description: Client version the server accepts.

variables.name: Language
variables.description: en = English overlay from Translations/en, empty = original Japanese.

variables.name: Public server URL
variables.description: Address players reach the server at, e.g. https://gameserver.yw-p.com (emulator setup) or http://your-ip:port.

variables.name: Database
variables.description: sqlite = saves in data/saves.db (nothing to set up), postgres = PostgreSQL (fill in the connection string).

variables.name: PostgreSQL connection string
variables.description: Only with Database = postgres, e.g. Host=db.example;Port=5432;Database=puniemu;Username=puniemu;Password=...

variables.name: Balance mode
variables.description: off, rerank (new ranks for old Yo-kai) or stats.

variables.name: Balance strength
variables.description: 0 to 1: how strongly old Yo-kai are raised.

variables.name: Anti-cheat mode
variables.description: off, log (admin -> Logs) or enforce (reject impossible results).

variables.name: HTTPS certificate (.pfx)
variables.description: Optional: path of a .pfx certificate (e.g. certs/server.pfx from Tools/make_certs.sh). Empty = plain HTTP.

variables.name: HTTPS certificate password
variables.description: Password of the .pfx file.

variables.name: Master data folder
variables.description: Upload the game's master tables here.

variables.name: Data download folder
variables.description: Game assets served to the client.

variables.name: SQLite file
variables.description: Player saves (Database = sqlite).

variables.name: Server state file
variables.description: Admin panel settings, gifts, bans, secret words.

variables.name: Translations folder
variables.description: Dictionaries; add generated machine*.json here.

variables.name: Events folder
variables.description: Event packs and history.json.

variables.name: Asset overlay folder
variables.description: Replacement asset files.

variables.name: Web folder
variables.description: In-game web page files (part of the build).
